OUTVERTS are OUTLET adverts that are too big to fit in OUTBOARD! If you send in an advert or any message that is too big for our OUTBOARD section then it will go in OUTVERTS.

There is NO CHARGE to our OUTLET readers (even if you only buy an occasional OUTLET). Adverts stay in OUTVERTS until:
1. Crowded off by new ones (you can re-apply).
2. You ask for it to be removed.
3. We consider it finished.

---

### Chezron Software

**OUTLET EXTRA 1** — has the first 7 OUTCLASSES (best machine code for beginners ever!); JACKSOFT (m/code assembler); SINGLESTEP (run and display code step by step); COL80 (prints OUTLET text in up to 137 chars a line); OUTPRINT (prints 3 columns); OUTSTART (disassembler); UNITRANS+ (tape file to Disciple/Opus/Mdrive); TRANSBACK (Opus file to tape); OUTDEX (OUTLET index).

Only £3.50 from CHEZRON SOFTWARE, 34 Saltersgate Drive, Birstall, Leicester, LE4 3FF.

**CLIPPER 1**. This is a compilation of clip art images on tape, +3 disc or Disciple/+D disc and includes CLIP COMPOSER (lets you edit images by moving areas of the screen to other areas or to other screens to pixel position etc.), RTCLIP to add large text to screens and RTCLIPAID to let you type large text like a simple word processor.

The clip art is a compilation of over 50 screens, most with about six individual images of various kinds — PREVIOUSLY IN OUTLET, now with a show and print program.

Only £3.50 from CHEZRON SOFTWARE, 34 Saltersgate Drive, Birstall, Leicester, LE4 3FF.

**CLIPPER 2 TO CLIPPER 8** are seven discs of clipart images FORMERLY AS SOLD BY TEACHERS PET SOFTWARE, and many of these screens will gradually appear in OUTLET over a long period.

They are currently available on Disciple/+D disc, most with about 70 screens each with one to six images. If we receive sufficient demand we shall consider making them available on +3 discs and possibly tape, but they will need to be in compressed format.

Each disc in the CLIPPER 2 to 8 series (state which numbers you want with order) is £3.50 from CHEZRON SOFTWARE, 34 Saltersgate Drive, Birstall, Leicester, LE4 3FF.

**CATLOADER V.2!**: This is the BEST Disciple/+D file-handler, being a much-improved version of the one previously in OUTLET. It is very much faster to CAT the disc and selectively copy files, copying files up to 30K without reset (no limit if Betados). It includes a text reader for quick scan and print of text files, and a screen loader and display (with border colour change) — all automatic — just press the key letter to load BASIC, SCREEN$ or text!

All commands are with just one or two keys, so it is the FASTEST and SIMPLEST of ANY file-handler we've seen! One or two drives; selected file delete; RENAME also does case change (e.g. "name.C" to "NAME.c").

Up to the full 80 possible files on any disc can be displayed on two pages (toggled by the SYMBOL key); BASIC programs are listed first and different filetypes are in different colours (which you can now customise to taste).

The new CATLOADER comes with a printed, easy-reference manual. It is on general sale at £6.99 BUT ONLY £3.50 TO OUTLET READERS!

A version for +3 is in OUTLET 33 (does not include RENAME or the colour-customisation of the +D version).

CHEZRON SOFTWARE, 34 Saltersgate Drive, Birstall, Leicester, LE4 3FF.

**CATLOADER FOR PC LUNTER EMULATOR FOR PSEUDO-MICRODRIVE OPERATION!**

This is our microdrive version of CATLOADER now available on PC disc for directly loading into and use by the Lunter Spectrum Emulator in Microdrive mode. The Lunter emulator is available from BG SERVICES (see OUTBOARD).

This version does not include file-copying or rename, but will enable you to easily load and delete individual files with a single keypress!

Ask for PC Emulator CATLOADER. Only £2.00 from CHEZRON SOFTWARE, 34 Saltersgate Drive, Birstall, Leicester, LE4 3FF.

### Flexibase Services

"Software for Safety", 20 The Parklands, Droitwich Spa, Worcs. WR9 7DG. Tel: 01905 775840. +D, +3, Sam, PC. FREE Z80 Spectrum Emulator with PC versions.

* **ROADCRAFT TEST**: Based on ROADCRAFT: police drivers' handbook — also used by the Institute of Advanced Motorists and the Advanced Drivers' Association of the Royal Society for the Prevention of Accidents for their Advanced Driving Tests. The test is of use to all drivers. 45 questions in random batches of 5 at a time. Large text and large YES and NO answers (the latter with appropriate sound). Ideal for home and public show — bystanders can easily watch the proceedings and share the learning exercise. £6.
* **CYCLE CODE TEST**: Text/graphic test with virtually all Highway Code's special requirements for cyclists. 45 questions in batches of 9, large text and large YES+NO answers (the latter with appropriate sound). Ideal for home and public show; bystanders can easily watch progress and share the experience. £6.
* **SAFE TRAVEL**: Quiz & Guide, converted from Suzy Lamplugh Trust leaflet. Education for all on how to recognise, deal with, and avoid dangerous situations on foot, bicycle, car, taxi or public transport. Choice of subject information or random selection of 5 questions from chosen subjects for prompt user turnover at home, school, club or public events. £6.
* **HIGHWAY TEST**: HIGHWAY TEST now available for all motorists and L drivers for the new theory part of the driving test, with 96 random multiple choice questions on the motoring parts of "The Highway Code". Crown copyright data reproduced by permission of The Controller of Her Majesty's Stationery Office. Large text, sound, illustrations and score. For home, training & public show use. Spectrum +D/+3 & PC (Sam version under conversion). Highway test includes full version of FLEXIPAGE, text/graphics author with multiple use: interactive, free format and automatic display for beginners to experts to compose your own exercises. Send SAE for full list. £6.

**SAFE DRIVING VIDEO**

Used successfully as a training aid by Driving Services fleet car drivers, this quality recording covers many aspects of their course "Defensive Driving" using various approaches, including the driver's-eye view of the road during a running commentary from a former police advanced driver.

This video can complement the PC CD-ROM "Interactive Defensive Driving" or be used alone. Training videos tend to be expensive due to production costs. This one is reasonably priced at £35. Flexibase Services, 20 The Parklands, Droitwich Spa, Worcs. WR9 7DG.

B. Dowsland, 26 Elsie Street, Goole, E. Yorkshire, DN14 6DU.

**Video Digitizing Service:**
If anyone would like any (still) video images putting onto the Spectrum then drop me a line at my above address. My rates are low; as long as I cover my costs I am happy. Material must be VHS or Beta video cassette.

Cartoons usually come out best. Line drawings are ideal, but they must only occupy about 2/3rds of the TV screen both length and breadth-wise.
